newsitem.title: USA: EcoTyre sets 1-for-7 reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: EcoTyre sets 1-for-7 reverse stock split.

text.p: EcoTyre Technologies Inc said Monday its board has approved a 1-for-7 reverse stock split as authorized by stockholders at its May 29 annual meeting.

The company said the reverse split was required by Nasdaq as a condition for continued listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market. It is meant to increase the long-term marketability and liquidity of the company's common stock.
All shares of EcoTypre common stock will be reclassified as 0.1429 shares of common stock, the company said.
The company said the reverse split became effective Monday before the opening of trading on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
Holders shall have a right to payment in cash for fractional interests.
For the next 30 days, the company's stock symbol will be posted as ETTCD.O, it said.
